title: the Glass Steppe Rising Again
author: L. M. Nakamura
blurb: Wren Brightwater, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
